name: 50/30/20 Budget Planner 2026
description: The simplest way to take control of your money. This clean, printable planner uses the proven 50/30/20 rule: 50% Needs, 30% Wants, 20% Savings. Includes weekly check-in pages, a debt snowball tracker, and a payday savings automation checklist. Instant download, printable at home (A4/Letter), lifetime updates.
